description: This file contains platform-specific functions for handling firmware upgrades on certain hardware boards, such as 'watchguard,firebox-m300'. It defines functions to check the image, copy configuration, and perform upgrades based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks firmware image validity based on board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to the device based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process depending on the board type.
